name: Simon
title: CS Student · Frontend, Data & IT Infrastructure
bio: I build web apps and the systems they run on. As a frontend developer at Prenora Dynamics I modernize legacy websites, and at hackathons I've shipped AI-powered apps with Next.js, Flask, and Gemini. At home I run a Proxmox homelab with NAS storage and a WireGuard VPN. Right now I'm learning data science at CUNY Tech Prep and training for CompTIA certification at TechBridge.
